source.title: U144: serve the App on a real Daemon so the Enter, Request and Review stages can be rendered against it
source.body:
<!-- work-order:scenarios/ui-first-journey.md:U144 -->
## Outcome
serve the App on a real Daemon so the Enter, Request and Review stages can be rendered against it

## Acceptance
Scenarios: U144
Specification: [scenarios/ui-first-journey.md](https://github.com/saadshahd/roundup/blob/main/scenarios/ui-first-journey.md)

## Scope
`apps/desktop/vite.config.ts`, `apps/desktop/src/testing/**`, `justfile` (`harness-real`), `.agents/data/harness.md`

## Preserve
U26, U137, S4, D1–D10

## Dependencies
U143

## Delivery
Harness implementation merged in #410. Retained viewport captures: `artifacts/ux/U144/`.

Remaining acceptance: `u144_real_daemon.test.tsx` currently checks the rejected RPC response, but does not mount the App and prove `RpcError.message` appears on screen. Exercise a real Daemon rejection through the mounted App and assert the visible error. Keep the existing real-Daemon Room/Terminal, shutdown and viewport checks. Repair product code only if this observer exposes a failure, and preserve the listed Checks.

Observer: the real-Daemon rejection produces visible error text in the mounted App; run that regression and required checks, retain the result, and obtain independent review. Close this Issue only after that remaining acceptance is demonstrated. This releases the dependent journey audit #407; it does not itself prove the journey stages.

## Queue
Key: U144
Priority: 6
Mode: implement
Provider: claude
Migration state: ready

Imported from the Work table. The issue-backed queue is being installed; this issue does not create a second Builder. Completion requires delivery evidence, not a matching test name.

goals.statement: With the App mounted against a real `rupd` through the U144 served seam (`?daemon=1` / `createServedApp`), a method the Daemon rejects makes the Daemon's `RpcError.message` appear as visible text in the mounted App, proved by a `u144_` regression in `apps/desktop/src/testing/u144_real_daemon.test.tsx` that renders `<App>` and asserts the on-screen error rather than only the rejected promise.
goals.observer: Run `pnpm --filter desktop vitest run src/testing/u144_real_daemon.test.tsx` (and `just check`) on the delivering PR's head; the mounted-App rejection test passes and its assertion queries the rendered DOM (e.g. `screen.findByText`/`findByRole('alert')`) for the Daemon's message; the result is retained in a run URL and independently reviewed.

goals.statement: The existing real-Daemon U144 checks still pass on the same head: a Room created and its Door started by pointer yields a Rail row and Terminal that come from the Daemon, the choosers answer null and the Dock badge does nothing, and closing the socket shows `daemon exited by signal`; the retained 1280×800 and 700×800 captures in `artifacts/ux/U144/` remain, and U26, U137, S4 and D1–D10 do not regress against main.
goals.observer: Same test file run on the PR head shows all four existing `u144_` tests green alongside the new one; `just check` passes; `window.__checks()` readings and the U26/U137/S4 tests show no Check that passes on main failing.
